_readme: Targets monitored by `node index.js`. Each entry is checked in turn (serial,
round-robin) and keeps its OWN record folder under records/<id>/, so numbers
found on one URL are never mixed with another's.
Fields:  url      (required) the page to check
id       (optional) folder name under records/ — defaults to host-hash
label    (optional) name shown in the terminal — defaults to id
enabled  (optional) set false to keep the entry but skip checking it
notes    (optional) free-form, for your own reference
A bare list of URL strings also works: { "targets": ["https://a", "https://b"] }

targets.label: subroutine
targets.notes: seen in the pre-urls.json log; flip enabled to true to monitor again
